explanation: A ritual act where one gives something of value to God, as a way to show reverence and gratitude.
A type of sacrifice in which an animal is burned completely or partially on an altar as a gift to God.
An offering given to atone for sins and cleanse the person who has sinned.
The highest religious leader in ancient Israel, responsible for performing special ceremonies and sacrifices.
A structure where sacrifices and rituals are carried out as part of religious worship.
The most valuable and nutrient-rich part of an animal, often offered to God in burnt offerings and sin offerings.
An internal organ in animals, often used as part of a sacrifice to God.
Internal organs in animals, also used as part of sacrifices to God.
A symbol of God's presence and power, used in burnt offerings and other rituals.
A process to remove sin and impurities, so that one may be purified and restored in God's sight.
